guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Dockerfile build fails at the step trying to install python3.11 and related packages from the deadsnakes PPA on Ubuntu 20.04 (focal). The error messages are: "E: Unable to locate package python3.11", "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-venv", and "E: Unable to locate package python3.11-distutils". This indicates that the deadsnakes PPA currently does not provide Python 3.11 packages for Ubuntu 20.04, as per the verbose output from the PPA itself, which states that supported versions are Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy), 24.04, and 26.04, but not focal (20.04). Solution: Update the base image to at least Ubuntu 22.04 (jammy) to ensure availability of python3.11 packages from deadsnakes. Alternatively, consider installing Python 3.11 via other methods (e.g., source build or a different PPA) if Ubuntu 20.04 base image must be used. Also, after changing the base image, keep the rest of the Dockerfile steps consistent with the new environment. This fix is necessary before the environment can be properly set up and tests run.
